summary: count fallbacks to awaiting the run

replay.detail: Admission, delivery receipts, FIFO batching and replay policy are unchanged.

schema.detail: Adds the optional message_id string to harness.diagnostic for content-free fallback correlation. The registry digest changes; no database migration or index change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: OMP hooks report one content-mismatch, no-message-start or timeout observation per fallback handoff, including unmatched runs that reject before the deadline. The existing daemon observability exporter counts the bounded reasons; identity is included in structured events, never metric labels or message content.

downtime.detail: Observation does not release admission or change run/watchdog timeouts.

manual.detail: Publish the updated hook sets and refresh eligible seats using the normal activation workflow to observe fallback counts.

recovery.detail: No new rollback restrictions or persistent state changes.
